schemas.name: analyze_optical_scene
schemas.description:
Classify a scene from an optical image using an LLM with vision support. Remember to mention if you pass a masking or SAR image in given prompt_text. LLM vision scene classification; returns a scene label string only (not for counting/detection).

Inputs: optical_image_path (str), prompt_text (str).
Output: classification result (str).

schemas.name: basic_calculator
schemas.description:
Evaluate a simple arithmetic expression safely.
Evaluates a simple arithmetic expression; no vision or spatial reasoning.
Input: expression (str) supporting +, -, *, /, //, **, ^ (as power), parentheses, numbers,
       and math funcs: abs, round, min, max, sum, sqrt, sin, cos, tan, atan, atan2, log, exp. Division by zero is not allowed. For round, ndigits is coerced to int.
       Constants: pi, e.
Output: dict with result (float).

schemas.name: compute_ndbi_by_multispectral
schemas.description: Shortcut to compute NDBI stats from a multispectral NetCDF crop or band folder.

schemas.name: compute_ndsi_by_multispectral
schemas.description: Shortcut to compute NDSI (snow) stats from a multispectral NetCDF crop or band folder.

schemas.name: compute_ndvi_by_multispectral
schemas.description: Shortcut to compute NDVI stats from a multispectral NetCDF crop or band folder.

schemas.name: compute_ndwi_by_multispectral
schemas.description: Shortcut to compute NDWI stats from a multispectral NetCDF crop or band folder.

schemas.name: compute_urban_mask_by_multispectral
schemas.description:
Compute an urban mask from a multispectral crop NetCDF using NDBI and sensor thresholds.
Derives an urban mask from NDBI thresholds; returns mask metadata/arrays.
Inputs: multispectral_image_path (str/Path), sensor (ls|s2).
Output: mask_path (str) to PNG

schemas.name: compute_vegetation_mask_by_multispectral
schemas.description:
Compute a vegetation mask from a multispectral crop NetCDF using NDVI and sensor thresholds.
Derives a vegetation mask from NDVI thresholds; returns mask metadata/arrays.
Inputs: multispectral_image_path (str/Path), sensor (ls|s2).
Output: mask_path (str) to PNG

schemas.name: compute_water_mask_by_multispectral
schemas.description:
Compute a water mask from a multispectral crop NetCDF using NDWI and sensor thresholds.
Derives a water mask from NDWI thresholds; returns mask metadata/arrays.
Inputs: multispectral_image_path (str/Path), sensor (ls|s2).
Output: mask_path (str) to PNG

schemas.name: crop_multispectral_image
schemas.description:
Load all available FAIR1M multispectral bands, crop to AOI, and save NetCDF outputs.
Inputs: ms_folders (List[str/Path]) and aoi (List[float] normalized [x0,y0,x1,y1]).
Output: List[dict] of mapping from ms_folder to saved NetCDF paths.

schemas.name: crop_optical_or_sar_image
schemas.description:
Crop an optical or SAR image by a normalized AOI and return the saved path.
Downloads and crops an optical or SAR image to the AOI; returns local crop path.
Inputs: image_url (str), aoi (List[float] normalized 0-1 [x0, y0, x1, y1]).
Output: cropped_path (str) pointing to the saved PNG on disk.

schemas.name: describe_optical_object
schemas.description:
Describe object attributes (e.g., color) from an optical image via an LLM.
LLM vision description of a named object’s attributes; not for detection or counting.
Inputs: optical_image_path (str), object_name (str).
Output: dict with `description` (str), or `error`.

schemas.name: get_bbox_geospatial_relationship
schemas.description:
Compute a coarse relative geospatial relationship between two locations.
Computes relative geospatial relation (e.g., north/south/east/west) between boxes/points.
Inputs: loc_a (List[float]) and loc_b (List[float]) as [x, y] or [x0,y0,x1,y1] (centroid used).
Output: dict with direction (str) and dx, dy (float).

schemas.name: get_building_mask_by_optical_image
schemas.description:
Run object detection model to extract building masks for the provided image URLs.
Building extraction shortcut; returns binary building masks per URL.
Inputs: optical_image_urls (List[str]).
Output: Dict[str, List[dict]] with mask_url metadata per image URL.

schemas.name: get_mask_geospatial_relationship
schemas.description:
Compute basic geospatial relationships between two binary masks.
Computes overlap/IoU and coverage stats between two binary masks.
Inputs: mask_a, mask_b as binary mask URLs/paths (PNG read if URL/path).
Output: dict with intersection, union, iou, and coverage stats.

schemas.name: get_multispectral_list
schemas.description:
Get several multispectral dataset locations (e.g., Sentinel-2/Landsat) for a given multispectral dataset location.
Lists multispectral dataset folders covering the scene identified by a reference ms_folder.
Inputs: ms_folder (str/Path), sensor (str: s2 or ls), start_date/end_date (required str/ISO date).
Output: List[dict] of multispectral entries with ms_folder and capture_time.

schemas.name: get_next_multispectral
schemas.description:
Return the next multispectral folder after a reference date.
Inputs: ms_folder (str/Path), sensor (str: s2 or ls), reference_date (str/ISO date).
Output: Optional[dict] entry with ms_folder and capture_time from the cached index.

schemas.name: get_next_optical_image
schemas.description:
Return the closest later RGB image URL to the given image.
Inputs: optical_image_path (str/Path), reference_date (YYYY-MM-DD).
Output: Optional entry with image URL, capture time, and size/GSD metadata.

schemas.name: get_object_bbox_by_optical_image
schemas.description:
Detect objects from optical images using text prompts and return bounding boxes. Text-prompt detection; returns per-URL metadata plus bounding boxes.
Inputs: optical_image_urls (List[str]), text_prompt (str).
Output:
  - If one URL: {"image": {image_url, image_size, gsd}, "detections": List[dict]{bbox, score, label}}.
  - If multiple URLs: List of {"image": {...}, "detections": [...]} entries in input order.

schemas.name: get_object_bbox_by_optical_sar_image
schemas.description: Object bbox selection using an optical+SAR pair and a text prompt.

schemas.name: get_object_bbox_by_sar_image
schemas.description:
SAR text-prompt bbox tool using cached ground truth + optional LLM label filtering.

Inputs: sar_image_urls (List[str]), text_prompt (str).
Output: Dict[str, List[dict]].

schemas.name: get_object_mask_by_optical_image
schemas.description:
Segment optical images using a text prompt and return binary mask URLs.
Text-prompt segmentation; returns per-URL list of mask metadata pointing to saved PNGs.
Inputs: optical_image_urls (List[str]), text_prompt (str).
Output: Dict[str, dict] mapping optical_image_url -> {
    "image": {image_url, image_size, gsd},
    "masks": List[dict]{label, mask_url, bbox, size, score, method},
}.

schemas.name: get_optical_from_sar
schemas.description:
Return the optical companion for a SAR input.
Returns paired optical URL/path for the given SAR image; no detection or analysis.
Inputs: sar_image_path (str/Path).
Output: Optional[str] relative optical image path.

schemas.name: get_optical_image_list
schemas.description:
List RGB images co-located with the provided frame, ordered by timestamp or frame index. Only return lists optical images without analyze content.
Inputs: optical_image_path (str/Path), start_date/end_date (required YYYY-MM-DD).
Output: List of entries containing each image URL, capture time, and optional size/GSD metadata.

schemas.name: get_previous_multispectral
schemas.description:
Return the most recent multispectral folder before a reference date.
Inputs: ms_folder (str/Path), sensor (str: s2 or ls), reference_date (str/ISO date).
Output: Optional[dict] entry with ms_folder and capture_time from the cached index.

schemas.name: get_previous_optical_image
schemas.description:
Return the closest earlier RGB image URL to the given image.
Inputs: optical_image_path (str/Path), reference_date (YYYY-MM-DD).
Output: Optional entry with image URL, capture time, and size/GSD metadata.

schemas.name: get_road_mask_by_optical_image
schemas.description:
Run object detection model to extract road masks for the provided image URLs.
Road extraction shortcut; returns binary road masks per URL.
Inputs: optical_image_urls (List[str]).
Output: Dict[str, List[dict]] with mask_url metadata per image URL.

schemas.name: get_sar_from_optical
schemas.description:
Return the SAR companion for an optical input.
Returns paired SAR URL/path for the given optical image; no detection or analysis.
Inputs: optical_image_path (str/Path).
Output: Optional[str] relative SAR image path.

schemas.name: move_down_optical_image
schemas.description:
Shift the crop downward by `move_pixel` while preserving width/height.
Input: optical_image_url (str) and move_pixel (int).
Returns a dict with `new_image_url`, `image_width`, `image_height`, `gsd`.

schemas.name: move_left_optical_image
schemas.description:
Shift the crop leftward by `move_pixel` while preserving width/height.
Input: optical_image_url (str) and move_pixel (int). 
Returns a dict with `new_image_url`, `image_width`, `image_height`, `gsd`.

schemas.name: move_right_optical_image
schemas.description:
Shift the crop rightward by `move_pixel` while preserving width/height.
Input: optical_image_url (str) and move_pixel (int). 
Returns a dict with `new_image_url`, `image_width`, `image_height`, `gsd`.

schemas.name: move_up_optical_image
schemas.description:
Shift the crop upward by `move_pixel` within the base image while keeping width/height constant.
Input: optical_image_url (str) and move_pixel (int).
Returns a dict with `new_image_url`, `image_width`, `image_height`, `gsd`.

schemas.name: normalize_bounding_boxes
schemas.description:
Normalize bounding boxes using a shared reference size (largest image in the batch).

Accepts a list of records, each containing bbox coordinates plus image
dimensions (`image_width` and `image_height`) along with `image_url` for
reference. Computes the maximum width/height across the batch and scales
all bboxes to that common size (i.e., values / max_width or max_height).
Returns the records augmented with `normalized_bbox`.

schemas.name: theme_index_lookup
schemas.description:
Return recommended index expression and bands for a theme (vegetation/water/urban) and sensor (ls/s2).
Returns recommended spectral index formula/bands for a theme; does not process imagery.
Inputs: theme (str), sensor (str: ls or s2).
Output: dict with theme, sensor, index, description, expression, bands (List[str]).

schemas.name: zoom_out_optical_image
schemas.description:
Expand the visible area from a cropped VHR image by padding `zoom_out_pixel` around the current crop.
Input: optical_image_url (str) pointing to an existing crop URL and zoom_out_pixel (int) giving padding in base pixels.
Returns a dict with `new_image_url`, `image_width`, `image_height`, `gsd`.
